### Null Island

- Coordinates: (0° N, 0° E)
- Not actually an island
- Not where your customer's home is:

::: {.notes}

This is not really an island, even the weather buoy is no longer there.

This is a humorous example of Geocoding gone wrong, but when you have thousands or millions of homes, some of them will be blatantly miss-geocoded. You want to minimize this so your customer get charged the correct premium

:::
